label: /app
description: Inspect, run and automate your installed Apps

children.label: list
children.description: List App installations with bounded paging

children.label: set
children.description: Show this kernel's App set: releases, approved capabilities and configuration

children.label: status
children.description: Inspect one installation's active and pending release

children.label: journal
children.description: Show retained installation update history

children.label: logs
children.description: Show an App's own log entries

children.label: worker
children.description: Show whether an App is running, dormant or stopped

children.label: start
children.description: Start an App now

children.label: stop
children.description: Stop an App until you start it again

children.label: restart
children.description: Restart an App

children.label: open
children.description: Open an App's view as a Tab in this session's Room browser

children.label: uninstall
children.description: Stop an App and remove its installation; its data is kept

children.label: update
children.description: Replace an installed App's release with a local .cxapp package; its data is kept

children.label: dev
children.description: Pack an App source directory, install or update it, and repeat on every change; its data is kept

children.label: dev stop
children.description: End the /app dev loop running in this terminal

children.label: operation
children.description: Show an App install or update: the one this terminal started last, or the operation you name

children.label: cancel
children.description: Cancel an App install or update before it completes

children.label: publisher
children.description: Trust an App publisher's signing key in this kernel

children.label: enroll
children.description: Ask this kernel to trust a publisher's public key file; you approve it in the approval panel

children.label: status
children.description: Show a publisher enrollment review: this terminal's last one, or the review you name

children.label: cancel
children.description: Cancel a publisher enrollment review before it is approved

children.label: automation
children.description: Route an App event to a workflow

children.label: list
children.description: List an App's automations

children.label: add
children.description: Route an App event to a workflow endpoint

children.label: disable
children.description: Disable an App automation

children.label: inbox
children.description: Route external events to an App

children.label: list
children.description: List an App's inbox routes

children.label: add
children.description: Route an external event type to an App's incoming event

children.label: remove
children.description: Remove an App inbox route

children.label: test
children.description: Send a test occurrence through an inbox route

children.label: connection
children.description: Let an App act through one of your event connections

children.label: list
children.description: List the connections an App may act through

children.label: grant
children.description: Let an App act through one of your connections (GENERATOR/CONNECTION)

children.label: revoke
children.description: Revoke an App's use of a connection

children.label: file
children.description: Answer an App's file request or offer

children.label: grant
children.description: Share local files with an App that asked for them

children.label: save
children.description: Save a file an App offered
